name: SEO.AI Publisher
author: dbseoai

sections.description:
Grow your organic traffic on autopilot with SEO.AI.

SEO.AI Publisher is the bridge between your website and your AI SEO teammate “Dave.” It enables the SEO.AI platform to automatically deliver, optimize, and publish high-quality content directly to your WordPress site. No manual uploading, no formatting, no hassle. Just a steady stream of SEO-optimized articles designed to help your traffic grow month after month.

The plugin will sync the content created in the SEO.AI platform to your WordPress site.

Key Features

  • Automatic Content Publishing – Receive fully written, SEO-optimized articles published directly to your site without lifting a finger.

  • Secure, Reliable Integration – Enterprise-grade security with modern authentication and strong protection against misuse.

  • Intelligent Media Handling – Featured images and media assets are added automatically for a polished, professional look.

  • SEO Plugin Compatible – Works with top SEO plugins like Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO and more.

More =

Privacy Policy
Terms

Configuration

  1. Get your API key from the SEO.AI platform
  2. Enter the key in SEO.AI Publisher > Settings
  3. Click “Connect Now” to authenticate
  4. Configure default author and post status

Support

For support, please visit https://seo.ai/support
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “SEO.AI Publisher”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Configure the plugin under SEO.AI Publisher menu
sections.faq:
Do I need an SEO.AI account?

Yes, you need an active SEO.AI account to use this plugin. Visit seo.ai to sign up.

Is my content secure?

Yes, all communication uses industry-standard encryption and authentication methods.

Does it work with custom post types?

Currently, the plugin supports standard WordPress posts. Custom post type support is planned for a future release.

What happens if I disconnect the plugin?

Your existing posts remain unchanged. The plugin only affects post creation/updates when actively connected.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Secure OAuth 2.0 with PKCE authentication
  • HMAC signature verification for all API requests
  • Automatic post creation and updates
  • Featured image support
  • SEO plugin integration (Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO)
  • Configurable default author and post status
